summary.en: Ethiopian forces have captured Gual Gemahalo near Badme and are fighting Eritrean-backed fighters in the area while also shelling Alamata. Somali militants attacked an Ethiopian base, killing 43 soldiers. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed warned Eritrea to stop supporting Ethiopia's enemies and announced that Ethiopian Airlines resumed flights to Aksum, while Kenyan trucks were escorted across the volatile Moyale border after a ceasefire was reported. The conflict produced 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopiske styrker har tatt Gual Gemahalo nær Badme og kjemper mot eritreisk-støttede soldater i området mens de også skyter mot Alamata. Somaliske militante angrep en etiopisk base og drepte 43 soldater. Statsminister Abiy Ahmed advarte Eritrea om å slutte å støtte Etiopiens fiender og kunngjorde at Ethiopian Airlines har gjenopptatt flyvninger til Aksum, mens kenyanske lastebiler ble eskortert over den ustabile Moyale-grensen etter at en våpenhvile ble rapportert. Konflikten førte til 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency or Amhara war is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
